describes: packages/plugin/actions createHoverPump, scripted and over the real dispatcher.

cases.name: pairs-are-submitted-back-to-back
cases.covers: Enter(A); then A to B while idle submits Exit(A) and Enter(B) together, synchronously.

cases.name: a-slow-transition-is-never-split
cases.covers: While a transition is in flight nothing else is submitted; after it settles the pump delivers the latest target.

cases.name: intermediate-targets-are-skipped
cases.covers: A to B to C to nothing to D while A is in flight delivers Exit(A) then Enter(D).

cases.name: same-target-is-free-and-exit-happens-once
cases.covers: Hovering the same target submits nothing; leaving to nothing exits once, and nothing again stays silent.

cases.name: event-flags-skip-tree-less-halves
cases.covers: events.enter false and events.exit false skip their half; a transition with nothing to submit settles on the next turn.

cases.name: reset-forgets-without-dispatching
cases.covers: reset drops the delivered target, so the next hover enters without an exit.

cases.name: target-identity
cases.covers: Targets compare by ref kind and page: object numbers, /NM, and index plus revision; a different kind or page is a new target.

cases.name: a-rejected-dispatch-still-releases
cases.covers: allSettled: a rejected dispatch releases the pump like a resolved one.

cases.name: an-unknown-ref-kind-never-matches-itself
cases.covers: sameTarget is false for a ref kind it does not know, even against itself, so every settle delivers the same target again.

cases.name: drives-the-real-dispatcher
cases.covers: Over the actions capability: the pump forwards the source hint, and the /E and /X trees run as hover-origin steps.
